metadata.source: Maharashtra State CET Cell; parsed from supplied CAP1 2023.pdf (official PDF export)
metadata.note: Figures in parentheses are merit percentiles. Parsed from the supplied official CAP Round I PDF. Overlapping category rows at PDF continuations were deduplicated by retaining the first occurrence. Home university name is not consistently printed in the cutoff tables and is set to "None"; verify individual records against the source where exact category alignment is critical.
